note: Two sample profiles for the three-minute demo of KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America 2026. Neither is a real person. Demo A wants to learn what Demo B can speak to, and Demo B wants to learn what Demo A can speak to. Both are open to meet and both share for the same talk, which ends on 12 November. Topics are labels from the conference's topics index and shared_talks holds a real talk title; both are resolved at seed time. Seed them with: node scripts/seed-people.mjs --event kubecon-cloudnativecon-north-america-2026 --file data/samples/demo-people.json --label demo
shared_talks: Platform-First AI Agent Security: Zero-Trust Patterns for Kubernetes
